name: 幽靈
subject: An eerie full-body tattered ghost, a hollow hood-like spectral face, flowing pale blue-grey ectoplasm, two long connected clawlike arms and a trailing wispy lower body; small muted violet highlights.

name: 石像鬼
subject: A crouched winged STONE GARGOYLE, complete muscular basalt-grey body, horned animal face, two arms, two clawed legs and full folded or opened batlike stone wings; dusty blue stone and sparse bronze lichen.

name: 牛頭人
subject: A full-body MINOTAUR, brown bull head with two ivory horns, dark chestnut fur, broad humanoid torso and two strong hooved legs; battered iron belt and bronze two-handed short battle axe, faded red waist cloth.

name: 雙足飛龍
subject: A complete TWO-LEGGED WYVERN, sand-olive reptile body, two large membranous forelimb wings, two hind legs only, complete tapering curled tail, ochre underside and muted copper membranes. No extra human arms.
